thread:
tess: Heads-up: noticed logs showing same request_id across retry attempts in Node SDK. Repro in sampleapp with axios-retry.
omar: that'll wreck our redaction and SLI math. paste logs?
tess: snippet:
```
2026-03-22T09:12:01Z INFO request_id=rtk9 start /v1/embeddings
2026-03-22T09:12:02Z WARN request_id=rtk9 retry attempt 1
2026-03-22T09:12:02Z INFO request_id=rtk9 start /v1/embeddings
```
jin: interesting. Node SDK uses async_hooks + otel autoinit, could be hook ordering so the retry reuses context.
sara: quick mitigation: have retry middleware set a fresh x-request-id header for each attempt; also add an opt-in x-log-event-id per log emission so redaction can key off that.
tess: implemented header injection in local branch = distinct ids in logs, but traces still tie to the original span.
omar: for parity with Python we should ensure retries create child spans or isolate span context per attempt.
jin: i'll prototype a log_event_id opt-in flag in SDK (non-breaking) and add a CI case in sampleapp to assert distinct x-request-id on retry.
sara: infra: check collector rules that might merge spans by trace id; we may need a collector tweak.
infra-bot: Filed DE-1301 "sdk: retry request-id duplication & log_event_id opt-in" assigned to jin.
tess: thanks all, will follow up with PRs and a short postmortem.
